meta.title: Go (Golang)
meta.tagline: Simple, fast and concurrent — the language of cloud infrastructure.
meta.description: Go is a statically typed language designed for simplicity, concurrency and fast compilation. Used for cloud infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes), microservices, CLIs and high-performance networked applications.
